nom: medicube Azelaic Acid Niacinamide Clarifying Toner

avis.titre: Making up for 20 lost years...
avis.texte: I’ve officially jumped on the K-beauty bandwagon, and Medicube has been a total game-changer. For years, I dealt with insufferable fungal acne. I couldn’t use anything without breaking out, no matter how much I washed my face. I finally cleared it with a round of Accutane, but about three months post-treatment, my skin started getting a little oily again and a few comedones popped up. I anticipated this because I've been introducing so many new products to my skin. To keep things under control, I picked up the Azelaic cleanser and this toner. The cleanser leaves me a little red, but this toner is incredibly gentle—no burning, no harsh smell, and zero irritation. I use it once or twice a day whenever I see a comedone starting, and it keeps my skin completely clear. Pro-tip: if you do get any initial redness, just follow it up with a light calming cream. At 39, I’m finally able to experiment with skincare and I'm officially obsessed. I’ve been stocking up so much on Mesicube products that my wife wants to kill me for taking up all the bathroom counter (and cupboard) space! I never write reviews, so when I say Medicube is the real deal, I mean it. Medicube, if you’re looking for a brand ambassador, sign me up!

avis.titre: Soothing, calming, and effective
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by this toner being as moisturizing as it is. It feels very soothing and comfortable when my skin is more sensitive. It did seem slightly oily while it was still wet, but it absorbed in fine without anything left behind. Blemishes were smaller, less red and raised by the next day.

avis.titre: Quality Korean product, good bang for your buck.
avis.texte: Not too drying, tones and cleanses. No fragrance that I can detect. Works well for inflammatory conditions such as rosacea and acne. I have not seen anti aging benefits but you can't have everything.

avis.titre: Love the Azelaic acid line from medicube
avis.texte: Love using this toner with the face wash and serum. Medicube rarely disappoints me. I feel I have had the most progress with my acne after switching to medicube. I still break out and have pimples. Dont expect results overnight. But I went to a dermatologist for 3 years and feel I have better results using these products on my own than I got when I was on oral and topical prescriptions.

avis.titre: Sizable and sensible.
avis.texte: The bottle is a pretty shade of light blue. The product is made of decent quality. For my skin type, it is too mild. Or not antiseptic enough to combat the ample oil production.

avis.titre: Mush get!!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this toner! I've tried over10 different ones and this is the toner that works for me. I do not see myself in the near future to be changing!!! It’s absolutely the best. I switched to only Medicube products!!!

avis.titre: Good for acne skin
avis.texte: Seems to help with my hormonal acne and closed comedones. Have also noticed an improvement in my blackheads on my nose. Not drying. Impressed so far!

avis.titre: Great feeling.
avis.texte: I have mild rosacea, this really helps. Feels refreshing going on.

avis.titre: さっぱり系の化粧水です。
avis.texte: テクスチャーはさっぱりとしていて、オイリー肌の私には合っていました。 顔に塗ったあとは皮脂が出るのを抑制されているような感じです。人によってはつっぱるように感じるかもしれません。 傷口に塗ると若干ピリピリとします。肌質によっては、使用後の保湿をしっかりとされた方が良いと思います。

avis.titre: Recommend
avis.texte: Excellent product. I am 59 and have sensitive skin. This is succeeding in freshening my skin without drying it out. No adverse effects.

avis.titre: Funziona
avis.texte: Preso come regalo per una ragmgazzina che ha problemi di "puntine" che compaiono soesso nel viso (soprattutto in fronte), confermo che funziona bene. Lo usa ogni sera da una settimana dopo la pulizia del viso e la situazione è molto migliorata. Data la mia esperienza positiva, lo consiglio.

avis.titre: It’s even better than its product description!
avis.texte: Leave it to Medicube to create a high quality product at an affordable price and that’s chuck full of amazing ingredients! If you aren’t familiar with Medicube they’re a very popular Korean skincare brand with a great reputation. One thing I love is that they listed all the ingredients for this toner on the product page so people can check it out before purchasing. I think that’s evidence to how confident they are in their product. This is a generous bottle of toner and the price is amazing quite frankly. The toner includes so many great ingredients it’s impossible to list them all. Not even their product description included some of the best aspects of this toner! Like the aloe, CICA ingredients, basil, sea buckthorn. I could go on but I think I made my point. It’s the kind of thoughtful product Korean skincare is known for. The toner itself is clear with the lightest tint of blue that naturally occurring. It’s a thin, lightweight toner that doesn’t make my skin feel heavy or greasy or even shiny or oily looking. It gives a very slight glimmer after use, almost a like an iridescent glow that’s attractive rather than unnatural looking. Although I do use some heavier toners, I do so at night since their shine is not a good fit (aesthetically speaking) for my skin. I have no such issue with this. avis.titre: Impressive Results from a Lightweight, Fragrance-Free Toner
avis.texte: I’m loving this Azelaic Acid Toner from Medicube! It feels instantly cooling and soothing on my skin, and I feel like my skin looks less red after I use it. The texture is super watery with absolutely no body, which makes it perfect for anyone who wants the benefits of azelaic acid but hates how heavy or gritty azelaic serums can feel. It absorbs instantly with zero stickiness and never pills under heavier products like moisturizer and sunscreen - I feel like it also makes my makeup application smoother. The hydration is great with ingredients like glycerin and glutamic acid, and the gentle exfoliation from the fruit extracts gives me a nice smoothness without irritation. It’s completely fragrance-free, which my sensitive, mature combo skin always appreciates. The ingredient list is fantastic - azelaic acid, niacinamide, and licorice root are all high on the list and great for brightening. It also has two of my favorite antioxidants with four different forms of centella asiatica as well as sea buckthorn extract. The bottle is simple and no-frill, but it's very large at 250 ml, and it will last a long time. I’ve been using it for over a month in both my morning and evening routines and haven’t even made it through a quarter of the bottle. My pH test strips showed it at about a 7, which is a little higher than most of my skincare, but it still works beautifully in my routine. Cooling, calming, brightening, and feather-light, this has quickly become one of my favorite toners.

avis.titre: Not for Sensitive Acne-Prone Skin!
avis.texte: I have acne-prone sensitive skin. This toner made me break out really bad all over my cheeks with mini comedones and whiteheads, and left me with dry patches all over my face. My skin was virtually clear before I used this. I gave it a shot for a few days but it didn’t improve and just made it worse. I’ve used Azelaic acid before without having this kind of reaction. Medicube is a reputable brand. I think this toner may work for others who don’t have sensitive skin, as it has really great ingredients in it. It’s too bad that those same ingredients didn’t work for my skin. It’s possible it’s the nicinamide. The formulation of this toner may just have too high percent of actives that it caused this kind of reaction. However, I’ve used azelaic acid products with higher concentrations before as a spot treatment and it helped fade breakouts rather than caused them, so I’m not sure. If you have sensitive skin, I don’t recommend this product. Instead, a non-comedogenic calming toner may be better suited for you. Otherwise, if you have normal skin to oily skin, this product may work well for you. I’ll stick to my trusty routine of 0.025% tretinoin mixed with moisturizer every few days at night.

avis.titre: Great lightweight toner
avis.texte: I've been using Medicube products for years and I haven't been disappointed by their effectiveness or quality, especially considering their bargain pricing. This toner is no exception. I use mine in a little mist bottle to minimize waste and it goes on so easily. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my face feeling sticky or tight. Niacinamide helps to even skin irregularities and strengthen the barrier, while azelaic acid can help prevent minor breakouts, so it's a two-in-one toner here. I also haven't noticed any irritation while using this, which bodes well for long term use. Overall, it's another quality release by Medicube. I love this brand!

avis.titre: Great collection of quality ingredients to target multiple skin concerns. Gentle. Noticeable results
avis.texte: This toner contains an impressive list of ingredients including azelaic acid for reducing redness and improving/minimizing acne, niacinamide and vitamin C for brightening, and panthenol and a significant number of natural extracts for skin soothing and hydration. The toner feels refreshing when applied, absorbs instantly, and does not leave any sticky residue on the skin. It was gentle on my sensitive skin. Having only used this for about a week, I have already noticed a lessening of the redness of my skin and a general improvement of my complexion. Medicube is a great brand, and this toner is consistent with the overall quality of its products. The bottle is large, and this toner will last for quite a while. Considering the quality of the ingredients and the noticeable improvements to my skin, I think this is a great value at $20 and will be purchasing it when I run out.

avis.titre: This Medicube Azelaic Acid Toner Did Wonders For My Combination (Horrible) Skin
avis.texte: This is the first azelaic acid product I've used and it has way exceeded my expectations. I have some frustrating troubled skin issues, mainly bumps on my chin and jawline with dry and oily combo issues on my cheeks and forehead. I have used this toner 2x/day for three weeks and two days, and I am genuinely thrilled with how my skin is looking lately. Much, much smoother, significant reduction of that mottled look, and dramatically less oiliness on the nose and forehead. This is now the only toner I use. I enjoy how cooling it feels. Not stinging or burning, just a cooling sensation that provides a nice "clean" feeling. It does not draw up the skin or feel tight (I have certainly experienced that with other clarifying toners.) Overall I think it is an excellent toner especially if you have combination skin issues like I do. It's also a very budget-friendly toner and I think the value is very much present here.

avis.titre: Great ingredient list, affordable but doesn't skimp on quality
avis.texte: I appreciate when brands are transparent with the concentration % of a product's star ingredients. This toner contains 4% azeliac acid and 2% niacinamide plus a TON of skin benefitting botanical extracts, HA, and a little ceramides. I already use a 10% AA serum and a 20% niacinamide serum, both of which help a lot with reducing redness and overall brightness, respectively. Adding this toner into my routine just provides an extra boost to existing routine or is something I can reach for on days when my skin is irritated. For $20, this 250ml bottle is quite a steal. It lasts a long time and is more affordable than similar toners.

avis.titre: Clean & Refreshed Skin
avis.texte: I don’t have particularly oily skin, but I do have an uneven skin tone that I hoped this toner can help with. It feels very clean & refreshing to use, and even though it helps people with oilier skin - it is not at all drying. Niacinamide & Azelaic acid are both good things for balancing the skin both in color and in texture, and hyaluronic acid is a hydration powerhouse. My skin feels clean and refreshed after using this, and with no irritation whatsoever it is something that I will be incorporating into my daily routine now. This is a good one!

avis.titre: Great toner leaves my skin feeling extra clean
avis.texte: I have oily, acne-prone skin, so I’ve been trying to really step up my cleansing routine. I start with a cleanser and then follow up with this toner to catch any leftover dirt or oil, and it works wonders. After using it, I can actually see the residue it removes on the cotton pad, and my skin feels incredibly fresh and clean. Since I started using this toner, I’ve noticed fewer pimples and my face feels noticeably less oily throughout the day. Overall, I absolutely love this toner. It has made a real difference in my skincare routine and I’m so glad I found it.

avis.titre: Great toner for redness and texture
avis.texte: I wasn’t sure what to expect from the Medicube Azelaic Toner, but it’s honestly become one of my favorite steps in my routine. It feels super light and soothing on the skin, and it’s helped calm down redness around my nose and chin without making me dry. My skin just looks smoother and a bit brighter after using it for a couple of weeks. I like that it doesn’t have a strong scent and soaks in fast, so it layers well with other products. Definitely a solid pick if you want something gentle but effective. Highly recommend all of Medicube products!

avis.titre: Great toner
avis.texte: I am a fan of medicube products. This toner with azaleic acid works well with my skin. It is a lightweight toner and doesn’t feel tacky on my skin. It makes my skin feel nice and hydrated all day. It is not drying and doesn’t cause redness or irritation. There is no unbearable fragrance or scent. It works well on my combination acne prone skin. Overall a great price for a great product.

avis.titre: Good quality just like you’d expect from medicube.
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Medicube Toner, and it’s honestly a really good product. It contains niacinamide and 4% azelaic acid, which help keep my skin clear, smooth, and bright. It feels nourishing and cleansing at the same time without drying my skin out. The texture is lightweight, absorbs fast, and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and balanced. It’s definitely a high-quality toner, and I’d buy it again for sure!

avis.titre: Helps with oil control but too harsh for my skin
avis.texte: This toner definitely works well at keeping oil under control. My skin felt less greasy throughout the day, and I like that it’s fragrance-free, which is great for people with sensitive skin. The texture feels lightweight and refreshing at first, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. However, it didn’t agree with my skin. Right after applying it, my face started to sting and burn for several minutes, and by the next day my skin was red and extra sensitive. It might be too strong for certain skin types, especially if you’re prone to irritation. I think it could be a good product for someone with more resilient skin who needs help managing oil and breakouts, but it’s definitely not a one-size-fits-all toner.
